data.long_meaning: The name Miguel is of Hebrew origin and comes from the Hebrew word ‘miguel’, which means ‘Who is like God?’. This powerful name is rooted in the Bible and is associated with the angel Michael. In Christian tradition, Michael is considered to be the leader of all angels and the guardian of the Church. The name Miguel carries the meaning “Who is like God?” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Miguel usually hope their child will grow to embody who is like god? and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Ο Μιχαήλ είναι επίσης ένα όνομα που αντιπροσωπεύει τη δύναμη και την ανδρεία, καθώς και την προστασία και την προστασία από τον εχθρό.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Miguel is a Christian name that originates from the Hebrew name 'Mîkha'êl' (Μîkha'êl) and means 'the one who is like God' or 'the one who is like an angel'. Saint Michael, the archangel, is one of the most significant angels in Christian theology. The name Miguel is also associated with strength and courage, as well as protection and guardianship from evil. In Christian tradition, Miguel is a popular name among Catholics and Protestants alike, symbolizing the qualities of a strong and faithful Christian.
